steps.en: OCMS checks the company is not on the opt-out list
steps.id: OCMS memeriksa bahwa perusahaan tidak ada di daftar opt-out

steps.en: Only non-excluded companies are sent for contact lookup
steps.id: Hanya perusahaan yang tidak dikecualikan yang dicari kontaknya
steps.why_en: Excluded companies are still sent for lookup first; the opt-out check runs after.
steps.why_id: Perusahaan yang dikecualikan tetap dikirim untuk dicari lebih dulu; cek opt-out baru jalan sesudahnya.

steps.en: The company ID is sent to the data source
steps.id: ID perusahaan dikirim ke sumber data

steps.en: The company's latest email is received
steps.why_en: Only one address is taken, from the first returned row; 'latest' is not checked.
steps.why_id: Hanya satu alamat dari baris pertama; 'terbaru' tidak diperiksa.

steps.en: The received email is saved on the notice
steps.id: Email yang diterima disimpan di notice

steps.en: The email notice is sent to the company the same day
steps.id: Email notifikasi dikirim ke perusahaan di hari yang sama
steps.why_en: The daily sending job is switched off in every environment setting.
steps.why_id: Job pengiriman harian dimatikan di semua pengaturan environment.
